newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades Times.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS upgrades Times.

text.p: DBS Investment Research said on Monday it had upgraded Times Publishing Ltd to an "accumulate" from a "hold" following the company's announcement of a 24 percent increase in 1996 net profits to S$24.08 million.

This, DBS said, was despite the fact that it felt competitive pressures would continue to weigh heavily on Times' businesses, which inlcude printing, book retailing and management of conferences and exhibitions.

"We think that the counter has been oversold of late and our assessed fair value of 17 times (at Singapore $3.45) suggests that there is overlooked value in the stock and that there may be some upside to the counter," DBS said.
Times shares closed at S$3.18 on Monday, up S$0.08.
